meta.title: Demo Portal - Business Workflow
meta.subtitle: Read-only reference for QA test scripts (QA environment)
meta.application: Demo Portal (the staff side of the Demo app)
meta.observed_on: 4 November 2026, signed in as a QA admin. Observation only - nothing was saved, sent or deleted.
meta.version_note: 1.0 - first version from a read-only walk-through.

purpose: The Demo Portal helps staff look after orders and customers. A user sees the day's orders, opens a customer record and reviews alerts.
exec_summary: Staff use the portal to triage orders each day and to check customers.
An admin also manages the users who can sign in.

roles.does: Everything Staff can do, plus user management

glossary.meaning: A request from a customer, shown with a status

global_elements.must: Typing finds customers; selecting one opens that customer

tooltips.text: Total number of orders in the selected period across all customers.

expandables.reveals: The order lines, one per line, with quantity.

screens.title: Orders
screens.purpose: The list of orders with a status filter and paging.

elements.must: 25 per page; the total equals the sum over all pages
Only orders with the chosen status are listed

criteria.text: The Orders list shows 25 per page and the total in 'Showing 25 of N orders' equals the sum over all pages.
The status filter lists only orders with the chosen status, and Cancel leaves the list unchanged.
The Customers list shows 10 per page.
A read-only run sends no write request and clicks none of the data-changing controls.

data_rules.rule: The total orders in the Orders header bubble equals the total in 'Showing 25 of N orders' (seen on 2026-11-04: 60).

steps.text: Open Orders and read the list.
Create an order with New Order.

permissions.evidence: Scanned signed in as Staff on 2026-11-04; read-only.

safe_to_test.effect: Opening is Y; saving creates an order

open_questions.seen: The Orders page says 'Showing 25 of 60 orders' while the header bubble counts 58 (seen on 2026-11-04).
open_questions.question: Which count is right, and should both use the same period?

out_of_scope: The checkout flow and email delivery.
person_judgement: Whether the order statuses are clear to staff.

change_log.what: First version from a read-only walk-through.
